Hey Impressives! In today's lesson, I want you to learn Python in 10 minutes, that's right, 10 minutes!

I'll give you a brief introduction to Python so you can use an online Python compiler, an online Python code editor without having to download anything.

I'll show you basic Python code, basic Python commands so you can take your first steps.

Let's start with the `print` command in Python, which allows you to "print" or display information on the screen, whether it's text or a number.

Then we'll talk about variables in Python. I'll explain what a variable is and how using variables will greatly help you in building your code.

Hey there! Want to learn this and much more in this quick lesson? Then come with me and I'll show you!
